name: How do luxury investment properties differ from standard investment properties?

mainEntity.name: How do luxury investment properties differ from standard investment properties?

acceptedAnswer.text: Luxury properties distinguish themselves through superior construction quality, exclusive locations, bespoke amenities, and a higher price point, attracting a discerning clientele. They often require specialized market knowledge for valuation and marketing. While standard properties might focus on mass appeal, luxury investments target niche markets seeking exclusivity and prestige. Kelby Contreras focuses on sourcing properties that offer unique value propositions, whether a penthouse in Brickell or a custom estate in Pinecrest.
acceptedAnswer.description: Luxury properties feature superior quality, exclusive locations, and bespoke amenities, catering to a discerning, high-net-worth clientele.
